newsitem.title: UK: LPC - ANZ arranges Turkish corporate loans.
newsitem.headline: LPC - ANZ arranges Turkish corporate loans.

text.p: LONDON, Dec 9 (LPC) - ANZ Investment Bank said it has completed two financings totalling $15.2 million for Turkish corporations.

Holding company Zeytinoglu-Holding has taken an $8 million, fixed-rate financing. The financing is for a two year period and was provided by Kuwait Finance House ($6 million) and ANZ ($2 million). The deal was enhanced with standby letters of credit from Esbank Eskisehir Bankasi.
Pinar Yam Sanayii ve Pazarlama, a dairy food subsidiary of Yasar Holding, received a $7.2 million facility. Kuwait Finance House provided $5.5 milion and ANZ provided $1.7 million.

The two-year financing was enhanced by standby letters of credit from Tukiye Tutunculer Bankasi. Both deals, which were jointly structured by ANZ and Kuwait Finance House, are murabaha financings, a type of Islamic finance that does not use interest.
